title: Wilted Kenyan Vegetable Stir Fry
description: A twist on the classic Italian vegetable stir fry, incorporating Kenyan flavors and wilted vegetables.

ingredients.name: kenyan vegetables (such as yams or cassava)

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced Kenyan vegetables and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until they begin to soften.
Add the wilted spinach and cook until wilted, about 1-2 minutes.
Season with Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional Italian seasoning if desired.
